subject: Hybrid Exec Briefing — SummitBank: calendar bridges & onsite handoff
messages:
From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@summitbank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Dover <mike.dover@summitbank.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid Exec Briefing — SummitBank: calendar bridges & onsite handoff

Hi Ava / Team,

Thanks for the quick intro. SummitBank (me + Mike on copy) are targeting a two-day exec briefing for our payments leadership and ops teams. Our constraints:
- Preferred window: week of Mar 22 so we align with internal approvals
- Need hybrid streaming for two tracks (exec + tech deep-dive) — at least 100 virtual seats; ~25 onsite seats
- Regulator review in the morning on day 1 means kickoff must be afternoon local time

Can you confirm:
1) Draft agenda and AV runbook — we need to share with our facilities/IT team for security review (they'll want port/bridge details)
2) Arrival windows for Redwood execs so we can coordinate parking / building access
3) Any preferred hotels you recommend for short stays (1-2 nights)

I attached a preliminary attendee list and our IT contact for firewall/bridge coordination. If you can lock calendar holds this week that helps a lot.

Best,
Kelly Tran
Director, Strategic Programs
SummitBank

[Attachment: SummitBank_Attendee_List.csv]

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@summitbank.com>, Mike Dover <mike.dover@summitbank.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 13:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid Exec Briefing — SummitBank: calendar bridges & onsite handoff

Hi Kelly — great, thanks for the constraints. Looping in Evelyn (events) and Aditya (ops) to lock logistics. Quick answers and next steps below:

1) Agenda + AV runbook: attached a working agenda (Agenda_v3.xlsx) and our standard hybrid AV diagram (Hybrid_AV_Room_Config.docx). These include our recommended redundancy (primary RTMP + fallback H.323 bridge) and required ports for your IT security review.

2) Dates: we propose Mar 22-23 (Mon/Tue) with a 1pm local kickoff on Day 1 to accommodate the regulator window. Day 2 starts 9am local. Please confirm if Mon/Tue works; if not we can shift to the following week.

3) Arrival windows: Redwood execs will aim to arrive morning of Day 1. For vendor setup we request site access on the prior day (Mar 21) after 10am. If your security prefers an earlier window we can adjust.

4) Hotels: we recommend The Easton (walkable) and Harbor Suites (shuttle) — Evelyn will share a consolidated hotel block and rates.

5) Calendar holds: we'll publish provisional holds today for all Redwood participants and send a short calendar description with timezone bridges (PST/EST/GMT).

Outstanding asks for you:
- Confirm onsite seat count (25 is our working target)
- Confirm summitbank-it contact for firewall testing and scheduled port open times
- Any dietary / accessibility needs for attendees

I'll create an internal ops checklist and ping you with the DocuSign PO link once we have final dates.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

[Attachments: Agenda_v3.xlsx; Hybrid_AV_Room_Config.docx]

From: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@summitbank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Dover <mike.dover@summitbank.com>, summitbank-it@summitbank.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid Exec Briefing — SummitBank: calendar bridges & onsite handoff

Ava — thanks, that all looks good. Quick updates:
- Mar 22-23 works for the execs but please confirm the 1pm kickoff on 22nd (we'll keep regulator block earlier that day).
- Onsite seat count: 28 confirmed (3 overflow).
- IT contact: summitbank-it@summitbank.com (on copy) will run firewall testing; they asked if you can provide an exact test window — can you propose one?
- We'll need a short speaker brief for our legal/regulatory team by next Friday (Mar 12) — high level talking points only.

I've attached our attendee list with titles and a note about two presenters who will be remote. Please add that to the agenda.

Can you send a DocuSign SOW/PO link and provisional calendar invites?

Appreciate it,
Kelly

[Attachment: SummitBank_Attendee_List.csv]

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Kelly Tran <kelly.tran@summitbank.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid Exec Briefing — SummitBank: calendar bridges & onsite handoff

Evelyn / Aditya — forwarding the thread so you have the attendee count and IT contact. Action items for Redwood ops:

- Evelyn: please create hotel block options (Easton + Harbor Suites) and hold a provisional room block for 4 Redwood staff arriving Mar 21, departing Mar 24. Also lock catering for lunch Day 1 (boxed) and plated lunch Day 2 (25 onsite + 3 overflow).

- Aditya: please propose a firewall test window (we typically do 30-minute test windows between 10:00-12:00 PST). SummitBank IT prefers exact times — suggest Tue/Mar/9 10:30-11:00 PST and Wed/Mar/10 10:30-11:00 PST as backups. Confirm if that's feasible. Also: secure the dedicated meeting room and confirm building access for vendor load-in Mar 21 after 10am. 

- Calendar invites: I'll publish provisional invites for the proposed Mar 22 13:00-17:00 local / Mar 23 09:00-15:00 local with explicit timezone bridges (PST/EST/GMT). Add tags: SUM-4821. Evelyn, please include the hotel and travel logistics in the invite notes once locked.

- Backup plan: identify two remote presenters who can take over if on-site presenters are delayed (Evelyn, flag internal backups). Also confirm our streaming vendor (we'll use Redwood's RTMP partner + vendor H.323 fallback) and budget for a dedicated link.

Kelly — will send the DocuSign SOW once we confirm dates.

Thanks,
Ava
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
